items.root_cause: Two defects in the one lane that could supply these cells, and a precedence that hid them. (1) Since 2026-09-20 every Hy-Vee product lookup was refused HTTP 400 because the fetch read $StoreId by dynamic scope and got a caller's [string] parameter, so the retired-store migration stopped dead and nothing Hy-Vee-only could ever price. (2) Even answering, the ask order ranked off-target rows by age alone, blind to whether a row was the ONLY store evidence for a commodity the board prices nowhere, so the two load-bearing rows sat about 59 days back in a 90-day carry. (3) Because cost-recipes fell back to db/label-prices.json, the missing cell never paged: seven live recipes priced five spice at a July walmart.com label and read as costed.

root_fix.what: (1) Build the Hy-Vee lookup body from script-scoped values by name and refuse a body Hy-Vee will reject; (2) read the board's own verdict back and ask first for a row withheld only for its store on a commodity with no cell; (3) retire label-prices.json as a price source, fail closed on any label: basis, and write the ruling into the repo rules
root_fix.exact_change: pull-regular-hyvee.ps1: Test-HyVeeLookupBody + Get-HyVeeLookupBody (storeId cast [int] from $script:HvRequestStoreId, set beside $LOC); Get-HyVeeStoreProduct and Resolve-HyVeeLookupOutcome use them; Get-HyVeeUncoveredIds + Read-HyVeeBoardVerdict (newest comparison + same-date candidates; Hy-Vee candidates WITHHELD-WRONG-STORE or WITHHELD-UNPROVEN-STORE on a commodity with no cell); Get-HyVeeAskOrder takes -UncoveredIds as rank 1 (after expiring sales, before other off-target rows, INSIDE the same budget). cost-recipes.ps1: Import-LabelMacros loads label-prices.json macros only (no price field copied); the label fallback removed; the label package SIZE still sizes a purchase package as before; Get-LabelBasisLines + a refusal (exit 2, costed.json not written) before the write. Golden re-baselined for the two fixture lines that priced from a label (Bulgur Wheat, Aji Amarillo Paste now NO PRICE BASIS).

items.resolution_note: Five spice and wild rice now price on the board from Hy-Vee Omaha #02 reads of 2026-09-21 ($9.99 / 1.75 oz, $10.99 / 16 oz). Cause: every Hy-Vee lookup had been refused HTTP 400 since 2026-09-20 (a dynamic-scope string storeId) and the ask order could not see which withheld rows were a commodity's only store evidence. Both fixed with fixtures; label-prices.json is macros only and the engine refuses any label: basis; ruling recorded in .claude/rules. Board and feed republished.
items.premise_verified: true on every measured premise, with one narrowing. Re-measured: label-prices.json has 59 rows and one commit (92dd24454); live dependence over costed.json x published-hashes was label 7 (all Five-Spice Powder) and ledger 1 (Wild Rice) exactly as the brief said, over 577 live recipes. Both commodities have include rules and a search term; both are CARRIED at Hy-Vee 1466 in carriage.json; neither was in comparison-2026-09-20 (the brief said 0 mentions in the comparison, true) though BOTH were in candidates-2026-09-20.json, withheld. The brief's candidate causes: rotation never reached them = TRUE (positions 879 and 895 of 1,228); band refusal = FALSE for both (no OUT-OF-BAND candidate); dropped for a missing field = FALSE; Hy-Vee lane BLIND = TRUE and it was the decisive one, a code defect not a wall. Class count re-derived: 23 of 577 search-termed commodities had no cell, 2 with live dependence.
items.deviation: (1) The brief expected wild rice at the carriage read's $8.99 Quality Wild Rice; the pipeline's own fetch prices Hy-Vee Select Wild Rice at $10.99, because the lane can only re-read products it already holds and 36825 can enter only through a human-adjudicated catalogue add. turkey-wild-rice-casserole therefore moved from the ledger's $3.42 to $3.69 a serving; recorded in leaves_open, not papered over. (2) The rescue re-read surfaced a latent wrong product (Morton & Bassett Harissa, a DRY blend, on harissa-paste, already on the board on 2026-08-29 per its curated link): adjudicated known-wrong and the link withdrawn before the rebuild. (3) Part 2's card road is the feed: export-feed re-run after the recost; spec cost snapshots were NOT re-rendered (recost-spec-cost-block's own header forbids using it for a price move), so each spec's stat.cost_ps follows on the next propagate. (4) The Hy-Vee lane ran twice by hand this morning (05:01 blind, before the body fix; 05:2x answered 15 of 15), ahead of its 08:00 slot.
